what: BUILD (split out of #14581 at round 3, manager review 2026-09-30 08:13Z): partial-fill MANAGEMENT in the prop executor. What #14581 ships: a resting entry with any non-size-matching position on its symbol+side is CONTAINED and trips the AUTO-REVERT halt, with an alert naming each position's size and SL/TP (and 'NO STOP OR TARGET' when naked). No journal write, no cancel, and the claim is released so the orphan check sees the position. What remains: (a) compare the held position's SL/TP against the ticket spec and repair it through modify_bracket; halt only if the repair fails. (b) past valid_until, cancel the ticket's remaining ENTRY order by exact ticket or order identity, never a protective leg, with retry and exhaustion as in B2. (c) report the partial as `open` with the filled qty so later closes go through the normal close path. (d) attribute a position to a ticket by size and time bounds, and release it otherwise. (e) re-alert hourly while partial or held. The prerequisite is PI-20260930-KMYJ5XC7-0006 ('Size' semantics). Tier 2, a HELD PR.
